description: Capabilities for the Calabi desktop shell's LOCAL origin (the bundled shell/index.html loading screen). These permissions are for plugins the Rust side invokes — notifications, updater, shell — not for the WebView itself. Note the window does not stay on this origin: the native side navigates it to the daemon's console at http://127.0.0.1:<port>, which is a REMOTE origin and therefore gets none of these. What the SPA itself is allowed to call lives in daemon-spa.json.
